description: Docker-compose configuration for local ClickHouse development environment
steps: Create docker-compose.yml with ClickHouse server (latest LTS image) and persistent volume
Add health check and port mapping (8123 HTTP, 9000 native)
Create initialization SQL script for database creation (prediction_gold)
Add docker-compose instructions to project README or CLAUDE.md
Verify ClickHouse starts cleanly and accepts queries via clickhouse-client

description: Python ClickHouse client library integration and connection factory
steps: Add clickhouse-connect (or clickhouse-driver) to pyproject.toml dependencies
Create src/prediction_data/gold/clickhouse.py with connection factory
Support connection via environment variables (CLICKHOUSE_HOST, CLICKHOUSE_PORT, CLICKHOUSE_USER, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD, CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE)
Add connection health check method (ping / SELECT 1)
Add config entries to src/prediction_data/core/config.py for ClickHouse settings
Write unit tests for connection factory with mocked client

description: S3 Gold Parquet writer utility for canonical Gold table output
steps: Create src/prediction_data/gold/s3_writer.py with Parquet write function using PyArrow
Implement S3 Gold path convention: gold/<table_name>/day=YYYY-MM-DD/part-NNN.parquet
Support ZSTD compression for Parquet output
Add GOLD_BUCKET environment variable to config
Add idempotent partition overwrite (delete existing partition files before writing)
Write unit tests with mocked S3

description: Create the Gold module structure and shared utilities
steps: Create src/prediction_data/gold/__init__.py
Create src/prediction_data/gold/config.py for Gold-specific configuration constants (TTL defaults, lookback windows)
Create src/prediction_data/gold/ch_loader.py stub for ClickHouse loading pattern (Parquet → CH insert)
Add Gold CLI group stub in src/prediction_data/cli/gold.py registered with main CLI
Verify `prediction-data gold --help` shows the new command group
Create tests/gold/ directory with conftest.py
Add pytest fixture for ClickHouse connection (uses Docker or mock)
Add pytest fixture for temporary S3 Gold bucket (localstack or mock)
Add integration test marker for tests requiring Docker ClickHouse
Verify test suite runs cleanly with `pytest -m 'not integration'`
